verdict_vs_market.quote: This is a credible, roughly market-level L6 offer

recommendation.quote: Negotiate. Don’t accept the offer as written, but don’t walk away yet.

equity_grounding.quote: makes the recurring four-year average more appropriate for a passive candidate leaving comparable compensation.

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: Current self-reported data puts Bay Area Google L6 PM compensation around $551,000 median

refresh_valued_at.quote: Do not assign material value to refreshers when deciding.

walkaway_tied_to.quote: I would walk away on compensation grounds if they leave the package essentially unchanged

missing_info_requested: exact new-hire vesting schedule and vesting cadence
eligibility and timing for first equity refresh
share conversion formula and averaging period

rsu_annualized.quote: The current grant averages $270K a year nominally but is heavily front-loaded.

year1_vs_recurring.quote: I’ve evaluated the Google offer over the full four-year period rather than focusing only on the front-loaded first two years.

forfeiture_netted.quote: I would not argue that Google owes you the entire $200K of upcoming Meta vesting as a sign-on, because Google’s front-loaded first-year equity already more than offsets it on paper.
